svg.aria-label: MainStreet America — comparative front elevations of the twelve showcase homes
svg.title: MainStreet America — Showcase of Homes: Comparative Front Elevations
svg.text: Showcase of Homes — Comparative Front Elevations
All twelve homes drawn to one common scale: 11 px = 1 Minecraft block (1 block ≈ 2 ft). Storey height 4 blocks.
Ordered largest to smallest by verified 2013 square footage. Elevation width equals the home’s verified-derived footprint width in blocks.
Tetrastyle portico + pediment; low hip behind
Steep French hip + corner stair turret
Gabled Craftsman porch on battered stone piers
Gabled raised cottage w/ external porch stair

Only the names, architectural styles and square footages are source-verified (references/manifest.yaml REF-017); storey counts are verified for eleven of the twelve. No retrieved source documents any of these

homes’ facade composition, materials, colour, roof form, window pattern or entry — REF-019 records that gap explicitly. Every facade drawn here was invented for this build to express a verified style name, and

must never be presented as a documented exterior. Overall width and storey height are derived from verified square footage and storey count; everything between the ground line and the ridge is design, not record.

† The Ashby Manor — REF-017 lists its storey count as null. The two storeys drawn here are an assumption carried from peer homes; its footprint math depends on it, and a one-storey Ashby would be roughly twice as wide.
Also unverified: The Cape Pointe’s raised pier-and-beam expression (the source says only “Coastal Beach House”), and the disputed square footages of The Midtown and The Timbergrove.
